auth: none (public, no cookies, JSON only, no CORS headers)
notes: 202 is identical for new, duplicate, confirmed, unsubscribed and suppressed addresses (no enumeration oracle)
One double opt-in confirmation email is sent; nothing is confirmed or notified until the owner clicks
GET|POST /leads/confirm and GET|POST /leads/unsubscribe (token in the query) are for people and mail clients, not the CLI

Both email links are scanner-safe (v3): GET /leads/confirm?token= and GET /leads/unsubscribe?token= only show a page with one button and change nothing. POST /leads/confirm?token= confirms and notifies once; POST /leads/unsubscribe?token= (the button, form-encoded, or the RFC 8058 one-click) unsubscribes. Unknown or expired token: 404 neutral page on both verbs.

The endpoint exists only where the gateway runs with LEADS_ENABLED=true (Align's hosted environments); anywhere else POST /leads/team-interest is a 404. A CLI must treat a 404 as 'not offered here', not as an error to show the user.
Rate limits are keyed on the canonical mailbox (+tag stripped, gmail dots folded) so a+1@ and a+2@ count as one address, and per caller network (IPv6 by /64).
